# Johnson Grammar School (JGS) Kokapet & Mokila, Hyderabad

> Johnson Grammar School has educated children in Hyderabad, India, since 1979. In west Hyderabad, JGS Kokapet is an IB World School for the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (authorised 10 April 2025), and JGS Mokila is a new campus planned to offer the IB and ICSE curricula. Admissions for 2027–28 are open.

## Key facts
- Founded in 1979 by S.R.N. Mudiraj. 47 years in Hyderabad, 500+ educators, 20,000+ alumni.
- The IB Diploma Programme has been offered at JGS IBDP, Mallapur, since 2008.
- JGS Kokapet: IB World School for the PYP. From 2027–28 it admits Nursery (EY1) to Grade 2. Address: Plot No. 65/6, Brindavan Colony, Narsingi, Hyderabad 500075. Phone +91 95132 51488.
- JGS Mokila: new campus at Sy No 208, SARK Garden Villas Road, Mokila, Shankarpally, Hyderabad 501203. Phone +91 90002 87940. Admissions enquiries for 2027–28 are open for Nursery to Grade 7. Planned: IB PYP (Nursery to Grade 5), IB MYP (from Grade 6), the IB Diploma Programme from 2028–29 (subject to IB approval), and the ICSE for Grades 1 to 7 (subject to CISCE affiliation). JGS Mokila is not yet an IB World School and is awaiting CISCE affiliation.
- Classes are capped at 24 students.
- Safety: background-verified staff, CCTV surveillance, a POCSO child-protection policy, GPS-tracked school buses, and a nurse on campus.
- Contact: hello@jgschool.in, WhatsApp +91 89770 06304.
